messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: The glass diver surfaces in a ruined courtyard.
scenes.visual_description: A cracked courtyard with fallen royal banners, the glass diver climbing out of a shattered window frame, helmet glinting.

scenes.caption: Mara the cartographer consults a map of the city.
scenes.visual_description: Mara unrolls a stained map on a broken fountain, compass in hand, studying the path ahead.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp flickers a warning from a doorway.
scenes.visual_description: An old stone doorway, the oracle lamp hanging from a rusted hook, its single eye flaring.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector snores behind a pile of rubble.
scenes.visual_description: A half-collapsed wall, the sleeping tax collector curled on a stack of ledgers, papers stuck to his sleeves.

scenes.caption: The tin fox scampers ahead to scout the castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Rusty iron castle gates, the tin fox darting between fallen stones, key-wind tail twitching.

scenes.caption: The glass diver peers through a cursed tower window.
scenes.visual_description: A spiraling tower with dark vines, the glass diver pressing his helmet against a frosted pane.

scenes.caption: Mara marks a safe route past the tower.
scenes.visual_description: Mara crouches behind a broken statue, inking a new line on her map, compass dangling.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a trap ahead.
scenes.visual_description: A narrow alley with scattered bones, the oracle lamp glowing red from a ledge.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector stirs but does not wake.
scenes.visual_description: A collapsed market stall, the sleeping tax collector shifts, mumbling, papers rustling.

scenes.caption: The tin fox finds a hidden passage behind a magic door.
scenes.visual_description: A shimmering magic door set in a wall, the tin fox nudging it open with its snout.

scenes.caption: The glass diver swims through a mirror into a locked room.
scenes.visual_description: A dusty chamber with a large mirror, the glass diver emerging like from water, helmet dripping light.

scenes.caption: Mara deciphers a coded message on the wall.
scenes.visual_description: A wall covered in faded runes, Mara tracing them with an ink-stained finger, compass set aside.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp guides them past an armored patrol.
scenes.visual_description: A wide street, empty armor suits standing in formation, the oracle lamp dimming its light.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector is accidentally rolled onto a stretcher.
scenes.visual_description: A makeshift stretcher of old banners, the sleeping tax collector snoring, papers trailing behind.

scenes.caption: The tin fox triggers a false alarm to distract patrols.
scenes.visual_description: A clattering of loose stones, the tin fox racing away as armored figures turn.

scenes.caption: The glass diver opens the final gate from inside.
scenes.visual_description: A heavy portcullis, the glass diver reaching through its bars to lift the latch from the other side.

scenes.caption: Mara leads the group across the crumbling bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A stone bridge over a chasm, missing stones, Mara at the front, map in hand, the others following.

scenes.caption: The bridge collapses behind them as they escape.
scenes.visual_description: The far side of the bridge, the span falling into darkness, the group safe on solid ground.
